conflicts.problem: Lesson 2's overview says the Kericho record is '14 rainy days in 20 years', while Lesson 1 says '14 of 20 past March days'. The fact sheet defines it as 1 day per year over 20 years. Lesson 5's overview also describes 'rain on one year's March day'. The lessons describe the same dataset inconsistently, so no Final Explanation can match all of them.

conflicts.where: Lesson 4 overview/observed vs fact sheet (day-state probabilities)
conflicts.problem: Lesson 4 gives P(rain only)=0.6, P(storm)=0.1 and P(dry)=0.3, which agrees with the fact sheet. However, it also says 'rain, storm and dry are not equally likely' and that the weather probabilities come from records and models. Lesson 6 then presents the same numbers by shading a grid of 100 days. This is a consistent teaching sequence, so it is not a defect.
